modules.module_title: Support preparation of the surface and materials

pcs.pc_description: receive the work plan and instructions from the supervisor/ painter
assist the supervisor/ painter to inspect and assess the surface to be painted
check the tools, equipment and hoses before use as instructed by the supervisor/ painter
prepare the surface under the guidance of the painter/ supervisor
protect the surrounding areas with drop cloths, masking or removing the objects
mix paint/ coating as instructed by the supervisor/ painter to achieve the desired consistency and drying time
stir the paint/ coating and colours thoroughly using separate stirring sticks or other devices
set up and test the spray system equipment and accessories as per the directions of the supervisor/ painter

modules.module_title: Assist in application of paint/ coating

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate brush or roller or brush/ roller combination or spray system or appropriate application method, as instructed by the painter/ supervisor
assist the supervisor/ painter to apply the paint/ coating to achieve the required opacity, finish, texture and sheen
operate the spray equipment under the supervision of the supervisor/ painter
work under the direction of the supervisor/ painter to rectify defects identified in the coating
clean up the work site and place the waste and discarded materials into appropriate waste bins or rubbish stock pile, guided by the supervisor/ painter
clean the tools and equipment with appropriate solvents as directed by the supervisor/ painter
dispose off the paint/ coating waste, water and solvents used in cleaning the application equipment, as per the instructions of the supervisor/ painter
store tools, equipment and unused materials safely
